transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm visiting today because I've been struggling with really severe mood swings lately. For over a year, I felt this intense, overflowing energy and was constantly hyperactive and irritable. But for the last six months, I've plunged into a really deep state of depression and constant sadness.
During these periods of extreme mood swings, have you ever experienced any break from reality, such as hearing voices or seeing things that others couldn't?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. I have never heard voices, seen things that aren't there, or had any other breaks from reality during these mood shifts.
I'm sorry, I didn't quite catch what you just said. Could you please repeat your question?

Can you tell me more about the periods of intense energy and hyperactivity - did you experience any impaired judgment or reckless behavior during those times, such as excessive spending or risky actions?

During those high-energy periods, I would constantly start multiple projects at once, take on way too much work, and become extremely social. I don't recall doing any reckless spending or having impaired judgment, but I just had this overflowing energy where I couldn't stop moving and doing things. It was more about being constantly active and overcommitting myself.
How long would these periods of intense energy and hyperactivity typically last, and did you experience any depressive episodes before or after these high-energy periods?
The periods of high energy and hyperactivity lasted for about a year and a month. After that high period, I went into a deep depressive phase that lasted for about six months.
Did you experience any periods of extremely elevated mood or irritability that lasted for at least seven consecutive days, or less if hospitalization was required, during your high-energy phases?

Yes, during those times I felt incredibly elevated and euphoric, but I would also get extremely irritable and angry over the smallest things. These intense mood shifts lasted much longer than seven days, going on and off for about a year and a month.
Did you experience any significant impairment in social or occupational functioning, or require hospitalization, during these periods of extremely elevated mood or irritability?

No, I never required hospitalization during those high-energy periods. And while I was definitely overworking and taking on way too much, I don't think it caused a severe impairment in my life, just a lot of exhaustion.
I'm sorry, I didn't quite hear what you said. Could you please repeat or clarify what you would like to know?

Did your high-energy periods meet the criteria for hypomania, where you felt elevated, irritable, or expanded, but not to the degree that it caused significant impairment in your daily life or required hospitalization?

Yes, that description fits exactly what I went through during those fourteen months. I felt incredibly elevated, irritable, and constantly driven with overflowing energy, but it never led to hospitalization or completely ruined my life. I was just highly active and constantly on the go.

To confirm, you experienced at least one major depressive episode, as evidenced by your six-month period of deep depression, and at least one hypomanic episode, as described by your high-energy periods, is that correct?

Yes, that is completely correct. I experienced a long period of overflowing energy and hyperactivity that lasted for over a year, followed by a separate, very difficult phase of deep depression for about six months.
